rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical layer or stratum, including layers in materials and cake.

example.english: This cake has a layer of cream in the middle.
example.traditional: 呢個蛋糕中間有一層忌廉。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 zung1 gaan1 jau5 jat1 cang4 gei6 lim4

rows.note: For a clothing layer, Cantonese normally says 件衫 when the surrounding context makes its under-or-over role clear.

example.english: It's cold, put on another layer.
example.jyutping: dung3 aa3 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for one level in a hierarchy, such as a social or organizational level.

example.english: This position is at a higher layer in the company.
example.traditional: 呢個職位喺公司入面屬於較高嘅層次。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zik1 wai2 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 suk6 jyu1 gaau3 gou1 ge3 cang4 ci3
